jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations match across ambulatory workflows, patient access, staff coordination, training, reporting, process redesign, and cross-site operations. Kevin’s ABA healthcare operations, intake, training, workflow, and systems experience map directly to the core work.
jobs.gap: The salary band starts below target and NYU prefers 3–5 years of supervisory experience plus ambulatory/academic medical-center exposure. Kevin should emphasize direct operational ownership, staff training, escalations, workflow redesign, and cross-functional coordination.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Transformation
jobs.location: United States · Remote · Travel to Boston
jobs.why: Outstanding healthcare implementation and operations fit. The role leads complex health-system implementations, clinical workflow design, operational readiness, cross-functional coordination, process optimization, and AI-enabled transformation.
jobs.gap: Specialty pharmacy, EMR integration, 340B, and medication-access experience are domain gaps. Kevin should position his healthcare operations, implementation, process design, systems, and stakeholder-management experience as the transferable core.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Insurance
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare-operations match involving insurance eligibility, benefits, prior authorization, documentation gaps, root-cause analysis, and building scalable systems so operational issues do not recur. Kevin’s intake, Medicaid/insurance workflow, troubleshooting, and process-improvement experience are highly relevant.
jobs.gap: The base range starts well below target and the role may expect deeper DME/post-acute insurance expertise. Kevin should target the upper end and foreground Medicaid, documentation, intake, payer-process, and escalation experience.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-operations opportunity in the Bronx with operational ownership across inpatient/outpatient activity, staffing, service delivery, and administrative execution. Kevin’s healthcare operations, training, process-management, and family-facing experience create a credible transition.
jobs.gap: Hospital-site operations are broader and more clinically embedded than ABA operations. Kevin should clearly translate his staff coordination, documentation, workflow, compliance, and issue-resolution experience into a larger health-system setting.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager (Process)
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-tech systems role centered on scalable workflows, process ownership, AI-enabled automation, cross-functional implementation, and operational analytics. Kevin’s CRM, automation, workflow design, healthcare operations, and systems-project background align well.
jobs.gap: The role expects advanced AI workflow fluency and independent data analysis, with SQL fluency or the ability to ramp quickly. Kevin should keep SQL positioned as foundational/working knowledge and lead with Power Apps, automation, CRM, process design, and practical AI adoption.

jobs.title: Expansion Strategy and Operations Manager
jobs.why: Good business-operations fit focused on scaling operations, cross-functional execution, structured problem solving, and building repeatable processes in a growth-stage company. Kevin’s operations, systems, reporting, and process-improvement background transfer well.
jobs.gap: Logistics/e-commerce expansion experience is a domain gap, and the role may expect stronger strategic modeling. Kevin should emphasize operating-system design, metrics, project execution, and cross-functional ownership.

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager, Revenue Operations
jobs.why: High-upside growth-operations role involving performance reporting, operational analysis, strategic projects, process scaling, and support for Sales/Post-Sales teams. Kevin’s growth operations, CRM, automation, reporting, and cross-functional background fit the operating model.
jobs.gap: Marketplace experience and stronger strategic analytics are advantages for this role. Kevin should emphasize CRM/process work, reporting, workflow automation, and prior marketing/growth experience without positioning SEO as his primary specialty.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Sales
jobs.why: Strong business-operations match centered on sales-process improvement, project management, operational rigor, structured problem solving, and supporting a scaling organization. Kevin’s CRM, reporting, automation, process, and stakeholder-management experience align well.
jobs.gap: Ad-tech and sales-operations context are the main gaps. Kevin should lead with systems, process governance, CRM/workflow automation, reporting, and cross-functional execution rather than industry-specific expertise.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong growth-operations role owning martech, lead scoring/routing, campaign structure, reporting, budget operations, and the connection between marketing and RevOps. Kevin’s CRM, automation, reporting, workflow, and marketing background are relevant without making SEO the core of the role.
jobs.gap: The role may expect deeper hands-on martech architecture and demand-generation operations. Kevin should emphasize CRM workflows, automation, data quality, reporting, and cross-functional marketing operations.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Citymapper
jobs.why: Solid systems-and-operations opportunity combining complex project management, cross-functional execution, data-informed problem solving, and product/technical collaboration. Kevin’s business-analysis, workflow, systems, and implementation background is relevant.
jobs.gap: The posting specifically values prior direct-report leadership and technical/data comfort. Kevin should emphasize any real staff leadership/training ownership and present SQL only as foundational/working knowledge.
